pr_title: Add configurable op_type for index watcher action
pr_body:
This allows the index action to work with data streams which require an `op_type` of `create`.

Fixes #64535

issue_context.title: [Watcher] Index action can not write to data streams
comments: I think op_type should made configurable on the index action, so that op_type=create can be set on the `IndexRequest` this action executes.

review_comments: maybe validate that only create or index op type can be used?
Thanks, @martijnvg. What versions do you think we should target for this?
